items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him at Bud’s house one day.

ctx.x: Or Willie Smith. I think they’re magnificent now. But when I was a kid, I didn’t like that at all. In fact, I was totally against it. When I heard Charlie Parker, I just fell – and Sonny Stitt – I fell in love with that. Rudy Williams.
Is that because of the absence of vibrato in Bird? I’ve heard that.
